Behind them the meadow and the sky dissolve into broad, soft pastel strokes, with the horizon softly about seventy percent down. The right tenth stays quiet. No drifting seeds. The viewpoint is low, just below the flower heads, so the clocks are seen against the pale hazy sky and the soft distant meadow, which lies low behind them. No trees, bushes, hedges or woods anywhere in the picture; any distant hills are soft, low, hazy, bluish and treeless, and the land is an open grass meadow.
